The *Daddallavimānavatthu* (Vv 34), translated into English as "Dazzling Mansion", is a verse narrative within the *Vimānavatthu* collection. The narrative centers on a conversation among devas concerning the superior merit of directing almsgiving toward the Noble Saṅgha as a whole rather than presenting gifts to individual monks.
